question: A conical vessel has base radius 31 cm and height 45 cm. Water is poured into the vessel until it is 2/3 full. Find the volume( in cm³) of water in the vessel.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 31 cm

Height (h) = 45 cm

Vessel is 2/3 full

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = (1)/(3)π r² h 

Volume when 2/3 full = (2)/(3) times (1)/(3)π r² h 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × (1/3) × π × 31² × 45

⇒ = (2/9) × π × 961 × 45

⇒ = (2 × 961 × 45 ÷ 9) × π

⇒ = (2 × 961 × 5) × π = 9610 × π

**∴ Volume of water = 9610π cm³**
